errors: fetch_ref.py first draft: a scripted string replace dropped the `if done.returncode != 0:` line, so every fallback fetch reported failure; caught by a real-clone run before commit.

doc_friction.issue: 'fetch a branch with git fetch --depth=40 origin <branch>' cuts main's fetched history to 40 commits behind the branch tip (measured 1,091 -> 45); proposed replacement in docs/reports/2026-11-17-depth-fetch-cuts-history.md (owner-gated).
'git fetch --depth=1 origin main' cuts a deepened clone back to one commit; should name platform/ci/fetch_ref.py main (owner-gated).
The 'predates the fetched history for every cluster' report (2026-11-17) is explained by a --depth fetch re-cutting history after the deepen, not by friction_rank itself.

notes: Critique mode (no agent-owned backlog items). Lens: doc_friction on history-reading tools. Reproduced in this clone: --depth=40 on a PR head cut HEAD 1091 -> 45 commits; --shallow-since on a branch 1091 -> 373. Shipped platform/ci/fetch_ref.py + run_workflow_locally auto-fetch uses it. Checks: unittest test_fetch_ref test_run_venture_tests test_slug_dupe test_shallow_repair test_check_shallow_refspec 72 OK; test_run_workflow_locally 233 OK; unwired_checks 200/216 pass, 16 skipped (no pytest); main_health 257/257 before the change; real clone: fetch_ref PR head / old branch / main all 1091 -> 1091. No backlog ids touched (backlog is under owner-gated prompts/).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: reproduce a git shallow-clone behaviour, write a tool with tests, wire callers, write post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
